title: Enigma explained
locators: Double stepping of the middle rotor
claims: The electrical circuit is activated after stepping
On these military rotors the turnover notch follows the index ring
III-II-I windows progress ADO, ADP, ADQ, AER, BFS, BFT, BFU
The plugboard physically supports up to thirteen disjoint pairs
notes: The page gives a period of 16926. We do not adopt that claim: the specialist Enigma Variations paper gives 16900, agreeing with complete cycle enumeration. Retain the page for the individually checked stepping sequence and other listed claims.

title: Enigma wiring
claims: Enigma I uses moving rotors I-V and lists reflectors A/B/C

notes: Profiles express component families across their history, not a dated key sheet or proof that every permitted combination was operationally used.
